frozen_scientific_scope.original_scope: Planned fossil-form study featuring open planar coil feeds into a long rising shaft ending in a large crook.
frozen_scientific_scope.representation: fossil-specimen, documented compressed lectotype-informed interpretation; includes explicitly disclosed historical plaster repair, not a pristine living shell

scale.basis: All first six dimensions from table p4, Fig2 also has50mm scale bar. Width185mm and axial55mm estimated from same-specimen photos, approximately15–20% uncertainty. Published h values are whorl height, NOT shell wall thickness.
scale.uncertainty: Dimensions describe flattened fossil, not undeformed animal. No reverse-deformation or pristine aperture restoration.

uncertainty: Selected specimen is nearly complete but partly repaired and compressed. This is an interpretation of its documented museum fossil form, not an unaltered specimen facsimile or living-shell restoration.

Published repair is identified by local whorl-height interval18–27mm, not an exact angular coordinate; do not assert an exact repair mask not supported by source. Use a subdued bridge rather than fabricated diagnostic detail.
Thumbnail edge photos do not permit precise thickness reconstruction;55mm working maximum may vary15–20%.
Stage is Lower Aptian, broad Cretaceous original retained; avoid old unsupported worldwide distributions or Barremian age assignments for this species.
